physicalEvidence.summary: Full 2024 Automation methods verify fine-tuned YOLOv5s detection feeding an actual xArm6/RealSense D435 pick-and-place system. A user selects the detected object; image-centering and distance-error rules plus SDK inverse kinematics guide approach, followed by predefined grasp/return movements. The learned component is perception, not a learned motor policy. The reported combined detection/localization/task success is 72.9%, with restricted tabletop workspace and grasping/depth limitations. All of this is former UW–Milwaukee work; current Lakeland apparatus and access are unverified. No clinical efficacy or unrestricted autonomous assistance is inferred.
